text: The Patriots enjoyed a dominant 45-17 victory over the Raiders on Sunday, with Drake Maye delivering his best performance of the season by accounting for five touchdowns despite missing his top receiver and playing without both starting cornerbacks—a resilience that film breakdown suggests marks a genuine turning point in his confidence and deep ball accuracy. However, the win came at a steep cost to New England's depth: left tackle Will Campbell suffered an MCL sprain in his right knee and is expected to miss game action, while running back TreVeyon Henderson sustained a high ankle sprain that could sideline him for multiple weeks. To address the roster strain, the Patriots signed running back Hassan Haskins and cornerback D'Shawn Jamison to the practice squad while releasing linebacker Jose Ramirez. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the situation at his Monday press conference as the team looks to maintain momentum despite mounting injury concerns.
